snippet.title: Day Seven - Puppet Combo Horror Game (Both Endings + No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Puppet Combo's take on "The Backrooms"', in this playthrough you could find both endings of Day Seven.
Twitter : https://twitter.com/rodteabaggins
IG : @rodteabaggins

Enjoy my content, want more? Consider subscribing and hitting that notification bell to be notified about my latest and most recent uploads.

I would've never known about the second ending if it wasn't for this video:
https://youtu.be/u-oONmuzr9A, thanks to the Puppet Combo subreddit!
